name: Doral Group Renewable Energy Resources Ltd
summary: Doral Group Renewable Energy Resources Ltd operates renewable energy, solar energy, and energy storage facilities in the United States of America, Israel, and Europe. The company develops, builds, operates, and owns ground-mounted solar installations, solar installations above water reservoirs and fishponds, and solar installations on commercial rooftops; produces and supplies electricity; provides farmers with technologies; and generates electricity from wind farms.
